response.sql: SELECT t.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS average_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS average_balance FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount >= 2400 AND t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency ORDER BY average_balance DESC LIMIT 10;
